data.text: Full suite after the timeline work: 1624 passed, 1 failed on two of three runs — test/prime.test.ts 'holds the line budget when notes and decisions carry newlines', Test timed out in 5000ms. Alone it passes in 2.3 s (≈90 command calls, each folding the journal). The suite grew by four files and a 12k-event perf case in the same fork pool, which fits the CLAUDE.md warning about machine load; not confirmed against the code before the change, because that needs a second checkout.
